title: Add pageRange
description: Add pageRange(items, page, size) returning the inclusive first and last index shown on a page, for the "Showing 3-4 of 5" label.

decoys.why_correct: last is an inclusive index, so the exclusive end minus one is right
decoys.valid_rebuttal: pageRange documents an inclusive range in its doc comment; Math.min(first + size, items.length) is the exclusive end, so subtracting one gives the last index on the page.
